name: TwistingData.excessWeight_mem_Icc
summary: With v = (s − i) mod N, 5P^v ≤ q; the excess weight is ±P^v/q, 1 − (0 or 1/q), or 0, all in [−1/5, 1].

steps.claim: 0 ≤ 5P^v/q ≤ 1 for v = (s − i) mod N (x = (b, s)), from 5P^v ≤ q (five_mul_P_pow_le_q at s − i, cast to ℝ).
Split the definition of excessWeight: at u_s it is P^v/q ≤ 1/5 (or P^N/q = 1 when s = i, less 1/q if also x = ū_i), at ū_s it is −P^v/q ≥ −1/5, otherwise 0; all these lie in [−1/5, 1].
